set.body:
Work key: L01.4
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product/backend/frontend engineer with local operator
Program scope: required

Scope: Make the vision visible through complete ordinary researcher and curator workflows.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Run the 10–15 minute scripted story: discover a project, create/intake data, inspect findings/metadata, retrieve exact data, propose/review/accept a correction and demonstrate unchanged historical bytes.
2. Show a fixed-release guest share, hidden restricted data/current head, revocation in a stale browser context, and release-bound review tasks/notes using real implemented screens.
3. Retain actual screenshots and step-to-role/action/hash mappings, measure presentation time and fix demo-blocking usability gaps; unavailable features remain visibly open rather than simulated.

Verification: Artifact-bound presenter run with screenshot/step manifest, allow/deny assertions and byte-equivalence checks.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/L01.4/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

References:
- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/service-distribution.md
- docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md

Blocked by:
- L01.3: bd-01M4X5MA8J51WRBGEHRJV94QGP
- F06.2: bd-01M4W5P7C89WZQYKNBKHNCFG6S
- W01: bd-01M4W40KKEG53SX6WJ17NQVQSV
- W02: bd-01M4W40KPVEFQSMWFEDZZC69SW

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: L01.4: Complete the guided local repository demonstration
